source: SVC-9 Fig. 9-8 board 3 schematic, PDF p. 10 (SVC-204D PDF p. 66)
wiring_source: SVC-9 Fig. 9-17 interconnecting wiring diagram, PDF p. 19 (SVC-204D PDF p. 75)
scope: Board-3 headphone amplifier input only: pin 7 via C19 to Q16 base node and its two DC bias resistors
active_boundary: Q16 base current and its dynamic input admittance are omitted from the passive-only calculation. Full headphone amplifier includes Q16/Q11/Q10/Q17/Q18/Q7 and C21 output coupling; no gain or speaker load inferred here.
uncertainty: Board-population variation, capacitor leakage/ESR, exact rail behavior, BJT parameters and jack contact behavior are unresolved.
